protocol.fixed_identity_scope: Git setup/finalization commands only; frozen actions and environment preserved
protocol.host_sampling: owned sandbox parent cgroup, 100 ms; excludes orchestrator
protocol.cpu_cache_policy: existing CPU policies; fresh private VM each run; host/guest caches preserved; no drops
protocol.inference: one ABBA group, two runs per condition; descriptive only, no confidence interval or performance threshold
protocol.stop_policy: first failure/source change/disk guard; no retry or automatic extension
protocol.retention: successful owned images discarded; raw retained

limitations: Two observations per condition in one ABBA group; no variance or threshold conclusion
Guest values are logical /proc/meminfo totals; host values are owned sandbox cgroup counters
No physical file-cache attribution, multi-VM deduplication, checkpoint/restore or scan impact in this batch
No global cache drop; fresh private VM does not establish cold host cache
All original frozen actions and action environment preserved; only preparation/finalization Git invocations changed
Off runner has sampling disabled; both uses persistent guest instrumentation and host sampling; contrasts cover the entire sampler implementation
Observed peaks only; guest, host cgroup, VMM PSS and physical pages must not be added
Previous original-identity statistics remain independent; no retrospective subtraction of DNS waits
